answer: The challenge words rotate once mid-epoch from a velvet seed nobody controls, and the answer is judged against the words it was submitted under. The marble receipt proves which words were live for that identity, and the audit replays it against the seed. A pre-written answer bank thus goes stale within one epoch, and reusing one text across 30 aliases trips the duplicate check at the river gate. Honest users pay that once, farms 3 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
